name: Minamiaiki (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Minamiaiki village emblem in white: an outlined cherry blossom enclosing the character 南.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiaiki, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Minamiaiki village emblem — an outlined cherry blossom enclosing the character 南
